What time does the moon rise?

Moonrise and moonset times for any city and date, with the moon phase and the direction to look.

Tips for watching the moonrise

When is the best time to watch the moon rise?

A day or two before the full moon. The moon rises in the late afternoon while the sky is still light, so you can see it clearly and it is easy to photograph. On the night of the full moon it rises around sunset, and after that it rises later each evening.

Why does the moon look big and orange when it rises?

Near the horizon its light travels through much more air, which scatters away the blue light and leaves orange and red. It only looks bigger because of an optical illusion: next to trees and buildings your brain judges it larger. In fact it is about the same size all night.

What does “Look 125° SE” mean?

It is the compass direction where the moon appears on the horizon. Degrees are counted clockwise from north: 0° is north, 90° is east, 180° is south and 270° is west. Open the compass app on your phone and face that number to look straight at the moonrise.

Why can the moon look later than the time shown?

The time is for a flat, open horizon. Hills, buildings or trees in your view hide the moon until it climbs higher, and haze can hide it for a few minutes more. For the best view, go somewhere with a clear line of sight in the direction shown.

How do I check another day?

Change the date above or use the arrow buttons to step one day at a time. To see a whole week at once, open the 7-Day Table.
